summary: Expose conversation admission, owner lookup and first-page timing stages in the existing performance report

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery changes; timing samples are process-local and do not write graph claims.

schema.detail: No database tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, digests or coordinated-upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: Adds fixed task labels to the existing performance report without changing conversation frames, session IDs, authorization, client schemas or peer transport. Existing incremental ownership lookup and cursor handling are retained.

downtime.detail: No additional startup work or replay wait; instrumentation uses the existing performance meter.

manual.detail: No operator actions, client re-pairing or configuration changes required. The existing performance endpoint exposes the stages.

recovery.detail: No persistent state change or new binary swap-back restriction.
